name: Hoarfrost Sidehandle
description: Set the baton flat to the forearm and meet the first blow with its full length.

name: Transfixing Rearend
description: Cross the rear foot over and chop the long arm down onto the opponent's elbow joint.

name: Chime Jolt
description: Hook the handle post under the wrist and tug it forward so the shoulder follows.

name: Torrent Spinpeg
description: Slide to the exact range where the elbow lies within reach of the rail and no further.

name: Sanguine Elbowside
description: Rap the elbow with a short stroke and let a pulse of qi shake the joint loose inside the arm.

name: Fastening Tap
description: Lay the rail under a straightened arm and press upward with steady qi until the elbow cannot flex.

name: Harpooning Gripbar
description: Catch the arm between rail and handle post and snap the long arm down with qi to break the elbow.

name: Lambasting Forearm
description: Wedge the long arm outside the elbow and spin once so a qi burst throws the arm off its weapon.

name: Granite Shortshaft
description: Begin the guard by letting the long arm hang loose from the handle until it starts to turn.

name: Handlepeg Assault
description: Rap the opponent's lead hand with the edge of the turning rail as it passes.

name: Gusttonfa
description: Lift the wheel's upper arc to meet a rising thrust and turn it up and away.

name: Silttonfa
description: Walk forward behind the spinning rail so that every step advances the guard.

name: Granite Tonfashaft
description: Feed a steady trickle of qi into the spin so the wheel holds against repeated heavy cuts.

name: Ironhandle
description: Stop the wheel suddenly and release its stored turn as a backhand across the opponent's jaw.

name: Knock Cuirass
description: Let a thrusting weapon enter the wheel and clamp the rail down on it with qi to trap it.

name: Tonfacloak
description: Spin both rails at full speed around the body with qi so a ring of turning wood shuts every line.

name: Rapthrash
description: Open the wheel outward into a rapid volley of rail strikes that pins the opponent behind their own guard.

name: Facet Forearmside
description: Stand with the baton before the chest and sense the opponent's reach against the edge of your qi field.

name: Sanguine Rap
description: Prod the end of the long arm at the opponent's belly to test and draw their guard down.

name: Equipoise Roundend
description: Step aside as the long arm sweeps across to cover the line you just left.

name: Tempered Spinflip
description: Turn the handle in the palm and let the long arm whip around into the opponent's side.

name: Surging Knock
description: Retreat exactly one pace so the opponent's best reach falls short of the rail.

name: Might Handlepeg
description: Rap with the rail while the qi field lengthens the stroke by a finger's breadth beyond the wood.

name: Facetrap
description: Jab the short end forward and let the field carry the point into a target just out of reach.

name: Equipoise Rearend
description: Spin the rail through the qi field so a blow is turned before it reaches the baton.

name: Might Spinflip
description: Extend qi a hand's breadth past the long arm's end so the stroke lands before the wood does.

name: Charter Shortshaft
description: Spread the qi field over an opponent's weapon arm and hold it down with the rail's pressure alone.

name: Aegis Tonfashaft
description: Line the short end up with the opponent's chest and hold the rail steady behind it.

name: Granite Spinpeg
description: Push the short end forward from the fist in one flat stroke that lands on the sternum.

name: Equipoise Gripbar
description: Turn the rail at the corner of the guard so a diagonal cut slides off the top.

name: Silt Roundend
description: Pass the opponent's lead foot with a hooking step and bring the long arm round behind.

name: Blaze Tap
description: Carry a pulse of qi on the short end so the jab thumps harder than the wood weighs.

name: Lancing Sidehandle
description: Spike the short end through a narrow guard with qi as the point that passes the gap.

name: Knocktorment
description: Thrust the short end and send a needle of qi a hand past the tip into soft armor.

name: Harpooning Gust Jolt
description: Whip the long arm around and trail a tail of qi that sweeps across two opponents in line.

name: Mantled Elbowside
description: Hold the left and right rails on separate lines so each covers a different side of the body.

name: Tempered Forearm
description: Jab both short ends forward a heartbeat apart at the ribs and the hip.

name: Handlegreave
description: Cross the rails like two banks and let the incoming weapon run between them.

name: Knock Sprint
description: Step around the opponent in a shallow curve as though following the lip of a basin.

name: Blaze Shortshaft
description: Rap with each rail in turn and time a qi pulse so the second rap lands where the first stunned.

name: Charter Forearmside
description: Cross both rails before the face with qi bracing the crossing against a hard downward cut.

name: Mayhem Forearmside
description: Hook one rail behind the wrist and the other behind the neck and pull the two lines apart.

name: Successive Spinpeg
description: Flow through block and strike on the left rail then the right in one chained current of qi.

name: Iron Gripbar
description: Turn the body like a river bend and crush the opponent's elbow between rail and handle with qi.

name: Facet Roundend
description: Spread both arms wide with the rails angled back like folded wing feathers to cover the flanks.

name: Rumble Rap
description: Rake the short end down across the opponent's forearm in the manner of a talon.

name: Lancing Rearend
description: Drop from a high guard with the long arm falling straight onto the opponent's head or shoulder.

name: Surging Elbowside
description: Glide in low and fast with the arms wide so that the body seems to coast on a current.

name: Sidehandle Thrash
description: Slap with the flat of the rail in a wide arc and flare qi along it like a wing beat.

name: Suppressing Rap
description: Clamp the rail and handle over a wrist like a talon and tear it back with a jolt of qi.

name: Jolttorment
description: Dive in from above and spin the rail through a full turn so the whole arc lands at once.

name: Aegistonfa
description: Fan both rails out and back again while qi holds the spread so the wings turn aside a volley.

name: Steadfast Forearmside
description: Hold the rail upright like a river bank so that a blow flows around the body.

name: Might Forearm
description: Whirl the handle in a small eddy and rap the inside of the opponent's wrist.

name: Chimehandle
description: Angle the rail with the current of the blow and ride it harmlessly past the shoulder.

name: Gust Spinflip
description: Hop from one planted foot to the next like crossing a river on stones while keeping the guard.

name: Chime Spinflip
description: Press the rail down on the lower leg until the opponent sinks in their stance.

name: Sanguine Jolt
description: Spin the long arm in an eddy and cut across the opponent's hand with qi at the turn.

name: Toxin Handlepeg
description: Drag the rail back beneath the opponent's lead leg like an undertow and qi tugs the foot away.

name: Glint Tap
description: Open with a wide strike and close with two narrow qi jabs into the opening it makes.

name: Gust Tonfashaft
description: Sweep the rail through the whole line of the opponent's guard like a flood filling a basin.

name: Thornjolt
description: Wind the long arm around a limb in a bend and hold the lock with a steady flow of qi.

name: Unyielding Gripbar
description: Stand with the rails canted into the wind and swear to give no ground behind them.

name: Mightrap
description: Rap in from the side as a crosswind strikes a sail and catch the opponent unready.

name: Rearend Fastness
description: Turn the rail into the blow in a sudden gust and spill its force along the wood.

name: Rapcanter
description: Shift the bearing a quarter turn and step along the new line without breaking guard.

name: Grinding Rap
description: Hit with the handle end in a gust of qi that adds the speed of a rising wind.

name: Rumble Handlepeg
description: Hook the long arm round the opponent's arm and drag it across like wind dragging a banner.

name: Granite Roundend
description: Shove the rail into the chest with qi at the back of the stroke to push the opponent off the line.

name: Shortshaft Torment
description: Swear the oath and whirl the long arm through a gale of qi that cuts a wide swath of air.

name: Charter Spinpeg
description: Spin both rails in an open wheel with qi so no gap stands anywhere on the exposed plateau.

name: Aegis Elbowside
description: Set the feet wide as on a plateau's flat ground and hold the rail upright before the chest.

name: Drubbing Sidehandle
description: Jab along the bearing you have taken and keep both feet where they stood.

name: Barcloak
description: Parry along the line of the plateau edge so the blow runs off to the open side.

name: Silt Jolt
description: Step sideways along the held bearing so the opponent must circle while you stay set.

name: Tempered Knock
description: Strike with the rail so that qi drives the opponent backward toward the nearest drop.

name: Sidehandle Cloak
description: Lock the opponent's arm at the held bearing and keep it still with qi in the rail.

name: Rapassault
description: Drive the rail down on a blocking weapon along the bearing and let qi snap the guarding arm.

name: Might Forearmside
description: Spin the rail through an incoming cut as the edge wind rises and return the stroke at once.

name: Annealed Tonfashaft
description: Take the oath posture with arms bent and both rails angled forward to ward the body.

name: Gust Tap
description: Poke the short end out fast and low into the soft ground of the thigh.

name: Bargreave
description: Roll the long arm over the forearm as a gale rolls over rock and deflect the cut.

name: Rappounce
description: Spring forward on the ball of the foot in a quick lift like an updraft at a cliff.

name: Handleassault
description: Strike with the rail as qi binds the intent of the blow so it lands where it was sworn.

name: Joltgreave
description: Wrap the long arm around a wrist and bind it fast with a gale-quick pulse of qi.

name: Facetbar
description: Spin the rail fast in a squall and let qi hold the turn against a flurry of cuts.

name: Raptorment
description: Whirl both rails into a sustained flurry of qi-backed strikes that drives the opponent back step by step.

name: Tempered Tonfashaft
description: Thrust the short end along the line of the wind and send a lance of qi past the point.
